attributes.action: Protect ALL existing UK visa holders from 10-year Long Residence rule changes
attributes.additional_details:
Thousands of students, workers, and families moved to the UK under the clear framework of the 10-year Long Residence route, investing their life savings and uprooting their lives.

The sudden abolition of this route penalises those who played by the rules and traps them in severe financial debt. We urge Parliament to reject retrospective changes and grant fair transitional protection to ALL existing visa holders currently in the UK, without excluding any arrival years.
attributes.background:
Don't change the rules halfway through!
We ask the Government to protect all current UK visa holders (students & dependents) from the sudden cancellation of the 10-year Long Residence route. Those who entered legally and invested time and money relying on the existing rules should not be penalised.
